This copy is a PSA 8, so the high stays at $6,000. Clark's Gold Vinyl 1/1 is left out. Sports Card Investor lists $675 for the same Oct 2, 2025 Kaleidoscopic sale that SportsCardsPro lists at $1,199.

image.alt: 2024 Panini Prizm WNBA Gold Vinyl Prizm number 147 Angel Reese rookie card, serial 1 of 1, in a PSA NM-MT 8 slab labeled certification 146338722

bids.take: I'm bidding on the 1/1 Gold Vinyl of her Prizm rookie, #147, in a PSA 8. Nothing of this exact card has sold, so the range starts at the live bid. If Atlanta reaches the Finals, this one-of-one can still move, and the PSA 8 holds the top down.
